product_metadata.title: Aojia Double Sliding Cabinet Organizer, Under Sink Organizers and Storage, Pull Out Under Sink Organizer, Under Cabinet Organizer Baskets with 2 Drawers
features: 【Multifunctional Slim Storage Cart】--The 3-tier slide out storage cart is 8.66" wide, which designed for tight spaces. The black storage cart is stylish, simple and beautiful, suitable for your bathroom, kitchen, closets, bedroom, laundry room or in-between your washer and dryer.

【Easy to Install】--The bathroom storage cart is very easy to install without extra tools. This partical small storage cart is great for extra storage. Mobile shelving unit organizer is made of high-grade plastic and stainless steel rods, lightweight and flexible, sturdy and durable.

【Brake universal wheels】-- 4 easy-glide durable wheels with 360° rotation. 2 of them with brakes make the rolling storage cart more stable, don't worry about slipping. 3-tier tidy storage cart can easily slide out of any narrow space, compact design fits great between washer and dryer, It is perfect to utilize tight spaces in your home for storage and organization.

【Drainage Design】--The black color and the holes basket design gives it a contemporary appearance.The plastic surface helps resist chipping or scratching. Mesh Basket shaped shelves are good for drainage, easy to clean, not easy to grow mold. Should be kept away from fire (Not heat resistant)
【Customer Service】-- If you have any problem with our slim storage cart, don't be hesitate to contact us. We replace or refund any defective products.
